game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: itsAnacondaVise
quote: Here’s my 2 cents. It launched at a very bad time let’s get that straight right away. This game should’ve launched with better hardware so that this 30FPS debate wasn’t a conversation. Oh and I will say the people who are annoyed by the 30FPS I completely get it, it’s valid. For a game that took 13 years to make 30FPS is no bueno. Main issues are pretty much what we’re all reading or seeing on reels. It took away a lot of things we are supposed to be able to do in a GTA videogame. You can’t kill protestors? Wtf is going on? The story is a mess unfortunately and I don’t think people knew what this game was really focused on cause they didn’t show damn near anything until the Netflix debut. The story is slow in the beginning picks up in later chapters but continues its drama with Lucia being a responsibility and that’s just not what GTA fans really want or knew they would be getting. I also still don’t get the whole no hookers thing, someone said so it doesn’t ruin your relationship with her. Wtf? Can you read that **** a videogame in a realistic but very UNREAL world. This is strange. The decisions of gameplay situations being limited and just a lot of the weird things in the game itself make me wonder who is in charge at the company. I saw 2 dudes in a bed together in one part. The hell is this? It’s a great looking game behind the filter of it running on 30FPS. That’s a fact. Detail is beautiful but this wasn’t a 10/10 like all the review sites gave it. That was really poor of them too all do just to stay on Rockstars good graces and stay on Rockstars good side or something? Like I’m generally confused. It’s not a perfect game at all. It was fun yes, I enjoyed parts for sure but also yelled at stupid stuff more than not. Also got bored seeing Jason be such a ball and chain in this “relationship”. I’m going through the motions with this one cause I don’t understand these review sites not seeing what a ton of us all see and feel. Maybe they were paid? Idfk. Oh well. It’s getting a low score from me just cause too many issues are piling up that I can’t stand. I’m story driven and this one is roughhhh folks.
